brief: Applies an expression to the items of a list, to all of them or to some, either rewriting the list (Perform) or only reading the results (Yield).
detail: Build one with new stzListPerformer(aList) or over a stzList object; it keeps its own copy, so what you passed in is not changed, and Content gives the result of the Perform calls. An expression is text in which @item is the current item and @i its position, such as "2*@item" or "upper(@item)"; braces around it are accepted. The W forms (PerformW, YieldW) choose the items by a condition written the same way, and the On forms by positions. Inside an expression len() counts bytes, not letters. YieldPairs does not return pairs today.
